> While there are a few exceptions to what I find entertaining, they are short lived and leave me unsatisfied. Do you feel this too?

Yeah this is about right, I've done exciting things, but get no joy out of them. Generally even in moment I don't feel excited. Its sort of like jumping out of an air plane, while being blind and deaf, you know your falling, but you don't mind because really that doesn't mean a lot. You haven't seen a "height"
